assets.caption: Figure 10.1  Material selection for sodium hydroxide service
assets.notes: Chart showing temperature (°C) vs % NaOH with three areas labelled A, B, C. Area A: Carbon steel – Welds, attachment welds and bends shall be post weld heat treated only for heat traced lines. Area B: Carbon steel – Welds, attachment welds and bends shall be post weld heat treated. Area C: Nickel alloys.
